posts.author: Nirwanda
posts.body:
Zelanus, a member of this very forum, commissioned a variety of icons from me. He asked me to share them with everyone in case they're useful to anyone else. I hope you guys like them. They're free to use and edit with credit for free and commercial projects, so have fun.
FYI, this freedom does not extend to AI or NFT usage.
You can also find them on my Itch Page.
https://nirwandas-assets.itch.io/zelanious-iconset
